incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: SEV-1 — 504 spike from EU-West edge gateways detected at 2025-11-02T13:33:09Z

anya: seeing a sharp surge of 504 gateway timeouts from edge -> apigw, error-rate ~22% (5m). dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/edge?panel=504

mike (sre_oncall): oncall ack. checking deploys & recent config pushes. anyone change edge timeout or proxy settings around 13:30?

deploy-bot: Config change: edge-proxy-nginx.conf v2.14 deployed to eu-west at 2025-11-02T13:29:57Z by infra-cd

nora: confirmed. that deploy reduced proxy keepalive timeout from 65s -> 15s in an attempt to free sockets faster.

samir: that could cause backend long requests to be cut mid-flight -> 504s. runtime traces show many requests with backend processing >20s. we have a mix of large-context batching requests for long-running inferences.

anya: extracted sample edge log: ```edge-proxy eu-west | 13:33:11 WARN upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream "inference-apigw-eu-04"``` we also see `upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream`

mike (sre_oncall): mitigation plan:
1) roll back edge-proxy-nginx.conf to v2.13 (restore keepalive 65s)
2) open circuit-breaker for heavy-batch routes
3) offload large-context traffic to dedicated region if possible

nora: initiating rollback: `/infra/cd rollback edge-proxy-nginx.conf --to v2.13 --region eu-west` — started

samir: suggest also adding a temporary header `X-Edge-Defer: true` that tells apigw to stream early headers to keep connection alive while backend computes. quick patch deployed as `apigw-feature/stream-headers`.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 13:35:02Z — edge-proxy-nginx.conf v2.13 active

mike (sre_oncall): opening circuit-breaker on path `/v1/stream` and `/v1/generate` for org=default-heavy. cmd: `rbctl cb set /v1/generate eu-west threshold=200 open` — applied

anya: after rollback and CB activation, 504s dropped from 22% -> 3% within 90s. still seeing sporadic 504s tied to apigw instance eu-04.

nora: draining eu-04 for inspection: `k8s drain apigw-eu-04 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` -> restarted pod and increased worker threads.

samir: apigw-eu-04 had a long queue of hung requests due to previously shortened keepalive; restart cleared it. also found a bug where streaming handshake retried and duplicated load on backend — patch queued.

anya: customer impact summary: ~12k failed requests in 20m window. Top affected: beta-analytics (4.5k), acme-integrations (3.2k), open-sandbox orgs (4.3k). Notified major customers via #acct-success.

acct-success-bot: Message to acme-integrations: "We're investigating increased 504s in EU-West; temporary mitigations applied (rollback, circuit-breakers). We'll follow up with root cause and timeline." — sent

mike (sre_oncall): temporary rate-limit for anonymous/sandbox traffic to reduce noise: `edgectl rl set /v1/generate 15r/s org=sandbox region=eu-west` — applied

incidents-bot: SEV-1 update: rollback + restart + circuit-breaker + rate-limits applied. error-rate back to baseline ~0.8% in EU-West. monitoring for 30m window.

anya: action items:
- infra: add deploy-time guardrail for keepalive change if backend processing > 10s avg (Nora)
- eng-runtime: add streaming headers fallback and patch for duplicate retries (Samir)
- SRE: add short-term alert p99>5s or 5xx>5% post-deploy for 10m (Mike)

mike (sre_oncall): handing monitoring to @lucy for night shift. lucy, I set a temp alert on EU-West 5xx>2% or p95>1s.

lucy: ack. monitoring & will escalate if anything.

incidents-bot: Incident SEV-1 resolved at 2025-11-02T13:52:31Z. Follow-ups filed: INC-2025-11002 (config-guardrails), INC-2025-11003 (streaming-fallback).
